hints.title: Monotonic Force Feasibility
hints.text: If it is possible to place m balls with minimum mutual separation D, it is certainly possible for any separation less than D.

hints.title: Sort and Binary Search Range
hints.text: Sort basket positions. Binary search distance D between 1 and position[-1] - position[0].

hints.title: Greedy Ball Placement
hints.text: Place the first ball at position[0]. Iterate forward, placing each next ball at the earliest basket at least D away from the previous ball.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all m-ball combinations is combinatorial and impossible for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on monotonic answer space takes O(N log(max_dist)) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate identifies greedy ball placement as verification oracle for binary search on answer.
complexity.notes: Exact analogue of Aggressive Cows problem.
